SELECT * FROM t_smart_job_log
AND ( job_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.searchWord}, '%') OR param ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.searchWord}, '%') OR execute_result ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.searchWord}, '%') OR create_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.searchWord}, '%') )
AND job_id = #{query.jobId}
AND success_flag = #{query.successFlag}
AND execute_start_time::DATE >= #{query.startTime}::DATE
AND execute_start_time::DATE <= #{query.endTime}::DATE
ORDER BY log_id DESC
